svg.title: GradePilot — Interactive Grade Calculator
svg.desc: An interactive weighted grade calculator with a live projection, grade categories, assignment score slider, school clock, and Chromebook battery widget.

xhtml:div.title: Chromebook battery
xhtml:div.xhtml:div: Live battery readings aren't available in this browser.

xhtml:section.xhtml:h1:
See what one grade
could change.
xhtml:section.xhtml:p: Enter your current grade, choose an assignment category, and move the slider to see how that score could change your overall grade.

xhtml:div.xhtml:label: Your current overall grade
xhtml:div.xhtml:div: Enter the grade currently shown in your class gradebook.
Your class grade is weighted using these categories.
Choose its category and predicted score. Your overall grade updates instantly.

xhtml:main.xhtml:p: Built and published by Youssef El Bouabidi.
